# ListElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides shared marker, indentation, spacing, and pagination behavior for lists.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `TextElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ListElementBase()
```

## Properties

- [`indent`](#indent): Indentation for nested lists (in points) Accepts a length: a number of points, `'7mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
- [`itemSpacing`](#itemspacing): Spacing between list items (in points) Accepts a length: a number of points, `'2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
